data.title: Nosice – the hillfort in 3D
data.excerpt: A 3D visualisation of the Púchov culture hillfort at Nosice, made by Naj from the ground plan drawn by Martin Olšovský, which can be regarded as the most accurate one available at present. The short video gives a reasonably good impression of the approximate appearance of the hillfort's defences 2,000 years ago.
data.metaTitle: Nosice – a 3D visualisation of the hillfort
data.metaDescription: A 3D visualisation of the Púchov culture hillfort at Nosice and its defences, based on the most accurate ground plan of the site, by Martin Olšovský.
